_comment: Example only. Copy to config/models.json (gitignored), put real keys there, run `node scripts/setup-trueforge.mjs`. Keys are sent ONLY to your local TrueForge (http://localhost:8790), never committed. You can also add providers in the TrueForge UI (Settings → Models) instead.

providers._comment: Local, free: Ollama (OpenAI-compatible). First: ollama create qwen3-forge -f config/ollama/Modelfile.qwen3-forge  (16k context, fits 8 GB VRAM with OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 and OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0; Ollama's default 4k is too small). Registered only with --with-optional.
providers.name: local-ollama
